capabilities: Paint hex tiles with colors, palettes, fill, and pattern stamp tools
Place hand-crafted SVG terrain symbols with variant switching
Draw rivers, roads, and border regions from waypoints
Add text labels that can link to vault notes
Export maps as high-resolution PNG/JPEG or print them
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. README warns that the main branch is a development branch and files should be taken from Releases. Supports 11 languages with automatic detection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw and store fantasy hex maps as editable files inside a vault.
summary: Visual hex map editor for fantasy world maps with painted terrain, SVG symbols, rivers, roads, borders, text labels, and PNG/JPEG export.
